Amy,
Thanks for your patience as we gathered all of the relevant information to follow up on our recent conversation regarding
Belarus. We enjoyed connectingwith you and theteamand are happy to tollow up ifthere are additional questions or
concerns. As we noted in our call, facilitating freedom of expression and protecting the safety of our users in Belarus and
elsewhere is extremely important to us, and we appreciate the opportunity to exchange with USAID on our efforts in
Belarus and elsewhere.
Below are some of the resources we discussed on our call:
• Access Now runs a hotline that Belarusian media and human rights defenders can use to report any safety or
content-related issues. They can help improve digital security practices and provide rapid response emergency
assistance if necessary.
• I have attached a booklet on our Meta Support Pro channel, which is designed to help political, governmental, and
nonprofit organizations quickly and efficiently resolve escalations with the assistance of a live agent. For more
information on this support channel, including how to access it and the services provided, please refer to the
